headline: CAM advises Elevation Capital on ₹963 cr Paytm share sale
sum: Elevation Capital sold One97 (Paytm) shares on the NSE/BSE for ₹963.6 cr — a notable early-investor monetisation.
detail: Elevation Capital V Limited sold equity shares of One97 Communications (parent of Paytm) on the NSE and BSE for aggregate consideration of ₹963.6 crore, undertaken on 22 May 2026. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Elevation Capital and its affiliates.

sources.name: Bar & Bench — Dealstreet
sources.blurb: “Elevation Capital V Limited has made a sale of equity shares of One97 Communications Limited (parent company of PayTM)…for an aggregate consideration of ₹963.6 crore.” — confirms CAM and the Ravi Dubey team.
